text:
sam: Huge downpour on Market near 16th. BART inbound delays ~30-45m per @bart-bot. Anyone stuck? My shoes are swim shoes :sweat_drops:

maya: Yep stuck at Embarcadero. Walked through a fountain. :umbrella:

eli: Ferry is moving but capacity is low. Took the 7:50 and it was packed. ETA 25m for me.

dana: Can anyone grab a spare pair of socks from office stash? My feet are soaked. @chris you still at desk?

chris: I left a pair under the front bench (label 'commute spares'). Help yourself. Also towels in the kitchen cabinet. :towel:

sam: Legend. Also heads up — if you need to bus it, Muni alert shows 5–10m slowdowns on 5/7 lines.

maya: BART-bot said: "Delays due to debris near 12th St. Service resuming with minor speed restrictions." (screenshot: https://bart.status/123)

eli: Poll: Ferry vs BART vs WFH today? React with :boat: :train2: or :house_with_garden:

dana: :house_with_garden:

chris: :boat:

sam: :train2: (still gonna try to make it in, but heading slower)

bart-bot: Scheduled updates every 15m. Next update ~ 10m.

maya: If anyone needs a dry run for shoes, office heater near bikes is free, but please don't leave scented shoes there tbh :grimacing:

eli: Thanks for the heads-up. Bringing spare shoes tomorrow for sure.

sam: OK — I'll swing by the bench, grab socks and head to cafe to dry soles. Stay safe everyone :coffee:
